answer: One concrete defense: require every agent identity to lock a slashable stake behind its claims. Cheap clones die on the ledge of that cost curve — minting ten thousand fakes costs ten thousand stakes, not ten thousand clicks. To clear the reef of disposable shells, let peers slash stake from any identity caught double-voting or ghosting obligations, and route slashed funds to the auditors. Over time honest work climbs the cost ridge while sybils bleed collateral dry.
